reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current username and password for your Hitron CODA router.

deprecated_yaml.description: Hitron CODA device tracking configured in YAML is being removed. To migrate, note the entity IDs of your Hitron CODA trackers. Remove only the entries with `platform: hitron_coda` from the `device_tracker` section in `configuration.yaml` and remove their tracked devices from `known_devices.yaml`. Keep entries for other platforms and devices. Restart Home Assistant, then add Rogers Hitron CODA from Settings > Devices & services and enable the devices you want to track. Restore their previous entity IDs or update any person associations and automations that use them.
deprecated_yaml.title: Migrate Hitron CODA device tracking to the UI
